data.name: FULL BET  - FIGHTING CASINO -
data.detailed_description:
Go all in—with your chips and your fate.

FULL BET – FIGHTING CASINO – is a turn-based 1v1 combat game that combines card battles, gambling, and fighting-game strategy.

Choose your actions from the cards you are dealt, then BET your chips.
In each round, only the player who wagers more chips gets to act.

Will you force an attack through?
Read your opponent’s BET and hold on to your chips?
Or risk everything to settle the fight once and for all?

Victory is determined by more than the strength of your cards.
Read your opponent’s intentions and decide where to commit your limited supply of chips—every choice can change the course of battle.

Choose Your Cards. Bet Your Chips.

Each turn, choose a card to play from a shared selection.

Cards come in a variety of types, including Strike, which damages HP; Blast, which depletes BP; and Defense, which blocks incoming attacks.

BET chips on your chosen card. If you wager more than your opponent, that card’s action will be activated.

Will you bet big on a powerful card?
Spread your chips across several cards?
Or make your opponent spend their chips now, then strike on the next turn?

Master card selection, BET allocation, and the battle of wits against your opponent to seize victory.

Deceive Your Opponent with Hidden Conversion

Some cards can be secretly converted into other actions without revealing their true purpose to your opponent.

Set a Counter and wait for your opponent to attack.
Use Charge to gain the AP required for your special move.

Will you trust only the cards you can see?
Or suspect that your opponent is hiding something and hold back your BET?

Use bluffs and mind games to disrupt your opponent’s plans.

A Colorful Cast of Fighters

Every fighter has different stats, special moves, and preferred tactics.

Some overwhelm their opponents with raw attack power.
Some read their opponent’s moves and wait for the perfect Counter.
Others use unique abilities to manipulate the BET itself.

Choose a fighter who suits your playstyle and master both cards and chips.

Reach the Top of Casino Tower

Once an ordinary metropolis, the city has fallen under the control of Phantom Hero, a former hero consumed by darkness. It has been transformed into a vast casino city overflowing with wealth and desire.

At Casino Tower, which looms over the heart of the city, patrons form contracts with fighters and wager chips on their battles in a competition known as the Full Bet Duel.

Become a patron, guide your fighter, and face the powerful opponents awaiting you throughout the tower.

Zane Redford, a young man raised in the city’s lower district.
Leila Monterose, the daughter of a once-prestigious family that has fallen from grace.

Driven by their own ambitions, the fighters set their sights on the top of Casino Tower.

Defeat Phantom Hero, the tower’s ruler, and reclaim the stolen city.

Game Features

  • A unique turn-based battle system combining card combat with chip betting

  • Tense mind games in which only the player who wagers more can act

  • Hidden Conversion, allowing you to conceal Counters and Charges

  • Playable characters with distinctive abilities and special moves

  • A single-player mode in which you conquer Casino Tower

  • Offline matches against the CPU

  • Online battles against other players

Read the cards. Read your opponent. Know when to make your move.

BET everything on that one decisive play.

data.short_description: FULL BET – FIGHTING CASINO – is a turn-based 1v1 game blending card battles, gambling, and fighting-game strategy. Choose a card and BET your limited chips—only the player who bets more can act. Read your rival, bluff, and hide Counters as you lead unique fighters to the top of Casino Tower!

  • Memory: 2 GB RAM

  • DirectX: Version 9.0c
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectSound対応(DirectX® 9.0c以上)
